proposal.reason: Primary change is in the extension-kernel path: adds a new OneShotPush AllReduce kernel/strategy, extends ext-kernel function indexing and dispatch tables, introduces new plugin workspace regions/state (PUSH_BUFFER/PUSH_PHASE), and adds plugin ABI wiring for cross-rank push block-limit negotiation. Also needs dispatch review because launch policy now depends on CU availability/dispatch masks (per-rank CU mask query, block-limit capping, and synchronized block-count behavior across ranks), which is a substantive CU/CE hardware launch-policy change rather than incidental caller edits.
